overview: Andorra is a tiny country high in the Pyrenees, between France and Spain. Its capital, Andorra la Vella, is the highest capital city in Europe. Andorra is a co-principality: its two heads of state are the Bishop of Urgell in Spain and the President of France. Catalan is the official language, and tourism, especially skiing and shopping, is the main source of income.

geography.text: Andorra is landlocked and almost entirely mountainous, made up of deep valleys surrounded by peaks of the Pyrenees. The Valira river and its branches run through the country, and almost all of its towns sit in the valley floors. Snowy winters make it a popular place for skiing.
